svg.title: Keep Borrowed-Authority Measurements Separate
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-borrowed-authority-evidence-boundaries; chapter number: 4; title: Keep Borrowed-Authority Measurements Separate; subtitle: Keyword positions, citation counts, referral visitors, and guide reductions answer different questions.; caption: Edward Sturm reports keyword contraction; CrowdReply reports citations; Spencer on Niche Pursuits Podcast reports referral traffic; Ahrefs describes Brian Powell's guide reduction.; assumptions note: Edward Sturm, CrowdReply, Niche Pursuits Podcast, and Ahrefs describe independent cases. Low and high retain reported endpoints, conflicting spoken counts, or subset-and-total counts as explained per bucket; they are not additive allocations or statistical confidence intervals.; note: Rankso SEO separates discussion visibility, contribution visibility, destination visits, and useful customer actions. SERPSUPPORT warns that rented rankings can be taken away.; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: No combined total — independent keyword, citation, visitor, and guide counts; buckets: label: Top-three keyword contraction; low: 3300; high: 10400; notes: Edward Sturm reports around 10,400 high-volume top-three keywords falling to 3,300 in one month. The endpoints describe a decline, not a forecast.; label: Spoken citation counts; low: 213; high: 230; notes: CrowdReply states 230 citations across five prompts and six AI models at the cited moment, then says 213 later. These are differing spoken figures, not a measured uncertainty interval.; label: Reddit subset and site total; low: 10000; high: 16000; notes: Spencer on Niche Pursuits Podcast reports nearly 10,000 Reddit visitors within 16,000 total visitors over approximately 28 days. The lower endpoint retains the rounded 'nearly' figure; the two counts overlap and must not be added.; label: Affiliate guides removed; low: 25; high: 25; notes: Ahrefs describes Brian Powell cutting about 25 guides while maintaining important pages. This is a portfolio reduction count, not a traffic total.
